standard_en.summary: ADDifT / Multi-ADDifT can, based on the original image
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: ADDifT / Multi-ADDifT 可按原图/目标图像素差自动生成 mask，减少无关区域干扰。

advanced_en.principle: ADDifT / Multi-ADDifT can auto-generate a mask from pixel differences between the original and target images, reducing interference from irrelevant regions.
